cases.question: 按Customer的AccountNumber统计SalesOrderHeader的TotalDue合计，取最高前三名含并列
cases.gold_sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT c.AccountNumber,SUM(h.TotalDue) v FROM SalesOrderHeader h JOIN Customer c ON h.CustomerID=c.CustomerID GROUP BY c.AccountNumber), ranked AS (SELECT AccountNumber,v,DENSE_RANK() OVER(ORDER BY v DESC) r FROM totals) SELECT AccountNumber,v FROM ranked WHERE r<=3

ORDER BY "排名" ASC, "总TotalDue" DESC LIMIT ?
